article.title: Why Data Lineage Matters When Metrics Change
article.why: 用 B2 英文理解 KPI 定義、versioning 與 data lineage 對歷史比較的重要性。
article.author: OpenAI learning editor

paragraphs.en:
A company can change a metric without changing its name. ‘Active customer,’ ‘conversion,’ ‘revenue,’ or ‘resolved case’ may look stable on a dashboard while the rules used to calculate the number evolve over time. When this happens, historical comparison becomes dangerous unless the organization can trace how the metric was produced.

Data lineage is the record of where data came from, how it was transformed, and which definitions were applied before a number reached a report. In a simple spreadsheet, lineage may be obvious. In a large organization, the same KPI may depend on source systems, filters, joins, business rules, manual adjustments, and scheduled pipelines. A small change at any step can alter the final result.

Imagine that a marketing team reports conversion as purchases divided by website visits. Later, engineers remove suspected bots from the visit count. The new conversion rate may rise even if customer behavior does not change. The formula name is the same, but the denominator is different. Without lineage, managers may interpret the increase as campaign improvement.

Lineage matters for investigations too. If a monthly number suddenly moves, analysts need to know whether the business changed or the measurement process changed. A versioned transformation history can show that a filter was updated, a source field was renamed, or a late-arriving table was corrected. This shortens diagnosis and prevents teams from building explanations around a data-processing event.

Good lineage does not mean documenting every technical detail for every audience. Different users need different views. Engineers may need table-level and column-level dependencies. Analysts may need metric definitions and transformation logic. Executives may need only a warning that a KPI is not directly comparable with the previous period.

Ownership is also important. A definition without an owner tends to drift. Someone should be responsible for approving material changes, recording the effective date, and explaining whether historical data will be restated. This creates a governance path when multiple teams use the same metric.

There is a cost to maintaining lineage. Automatic tooling can capture technical dependencies, but business meaning still requires human judgment. Teams should therefore prioritize high-impact metrics rather than trying to document everything equally.

The practical test is simple: if a number changes unexpectedly, can the team explain where it came from and what changed in its production path? If the answer requires asking five people and searching old messages, lineage is weak. Strong lineage turns a dashboard from a collection of numbers into an auditable measurement system.

Metric lineage is especially important when teams run experiments or compare year-over-year performance. If the population, attribution window, or exclusion rule changes between periods, apparent uplift may be an artifact of measurement. Analysts should therefore attach definition versions to important comparisons and state whether the historical series was recalculated.

A practical governance model can be lightweight. Each critical KPI can have a definition, owner, source, refresh frequency, known exclusions, and change log. When a material rule changes, the team records the reason and expected impact. This does not eliminate every mistake, but it creates a common reference for review.

Lineage also improves trust across functions. Finance, marketing, product, and data teams often use similar words with different calculations. A shared lineage record makes disagreements visible early. Instead of arguing about which dashboard is correct, teams can compare the transformations and decide which definition fits the decision being made.
paragraphs.zh: Data lineage 記錄數據從來源到 KPI 的轉換路徑。若 denominator、filter、population 或 attribution window 改變，指標名稱即使不變，歷史比較也可能失真。對重要 KPI 應保留 definition、owner、source、effective date 與 change log，讓團隊能區分 business change 與 measurement change。
paragraphs.ja: データリネージュは、データがどこから来て、どの変換や定義を経てKPIになったかを追跡する情報です。分母、対象母集団、フィルター、アトリビューション期間が変われば、指標名が同じでも過去比較は危険になります。重要KPIには定義、責任者、変更履歴を残す必要があります。

quiz.question: Why can conversion rise without customer behavior improving?
quiz.answer: Because the denominator or measurement rules may have changed.

quiz.question: Output: Name one KPI that should have a versioned definition.
quiz.answer: Explain what could change in the calculation.
